about:
Equipment Sales Co Inc. is based in Snohomish, Washington. Founded in 1989 by Scott Wilson, the company was incorporated to represent manufacturers of motor vehicle service equipment across the Pacific Northwest. In 1994, Kirby McFarland acquired the business and expanded it into a full distributor and contractor for automotive service equipment.

The company sells, installs, and services a range of automotive shop equipment including vehicle lifts (5,500 to 120,000 lb capacity), lubrication dispensing and inventory systems, compressed air systems, vehicle exhaust removal systems, and wheel service equipment. They also provide shop design, installation, training, and inspection services. Their technicians hold ALI certification for lift inspections.

They serve automotive dealerships, independent repair shops, municipal garages, and military maintenance facilities throughout the Pacific Northwest. Customers include car and truck dealers, independent shops, and municipal garages that use vehicle lifts.

The company distinguishes itself through factory-trained personnel and ALI-certified lift inspectors, offering warranty work for partner manufacturers such as Rotary Lift, Graco, and Champion.
